# mika-router

> An on-device AI agent for Android that operates apps and the web to get things done for you. - Modular design, zero-copy data pipelines and resilient clustering.

### mika-router 核心设计蓝图

# mika-router 核心设计蓝图

An on-device AI agent for Android that operates apps and the web to get things done for you. - Modular design, zero-copy data pipelines and resilient clustering.

本文档为 **mika-router** 的面向工程落地的模块化结构说明，重点覆盖 mika-router 与 mika 协同路径：

| 层级模块 | 核心职责 | 关联能力 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 编排接入 | 请求归一化与上下文装配 | mika-router |
| 状态索引 | 增量版本校准与去重记录 | mika |
| 静态产物 | 多端视图渲染与协议输出 | router |

### mika-router 协议约束与配置标准

# mika-router 协议约束与配置标准

本文为 **mika-router** 的核心规范说明书（围绕参数边界、序列化格式与运行时约束整理的基线规约）：

1. **元数据完整性**：每一篇详情页需具备独立标题、摘要描述及合法语种标识
2. **网络超时与退避**：远端请求启用显式超时上限与可观测失败计数（覆盖 mika）
3. **归档兼容性**：保留既有路径入口不破坏外部引用锚点（覆盖 router）

### Agent quick path

# Agent quick path

[简体中文](agent-quickstart.md) | English

For AI agents on a computer: follow these fixed steps to install Mika and connect the phone, without weighing options. Full details: [Install](computer-install.en.md) and [CLI](cli.en.md).

## 1. Resolve the latest release tag

```sh
curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/wangzan101/Mika/releases/latest   # read tag_name
```

```powershell
(Invoke-RestMethod https://api.github.com/repos/wangzan101/Mika/releases/latest).tag_name
```

Below, `<tag>` is that value (e.g. `v0.1.31`) and `<ver>` is the version without the `v` (e.g. `0.1.31`).

## 2. CLI or Skill

- Agent supports skills: **install the Skill by default**; it bundles the CLI script.
- Otherwise install the CLI: `pipx install 'git+https://github.com/wangzan101/Mika.git@<tag>#subdirectory=tools/mika'`.

## 3. Install the Skill

`<skills-directory>` is your agent's skills directory, as given in that agent's own documentation; the Skill goes into a `mika` folder inside it.

POSIX:

```sh
curl -L -o mika.zip https://github.com/wangzan101/Mika/archive/refs/tags/<tag>.zip
unzip -q mika.zip -d mika-src
mkdir -p <skills-directory> && cp -R mika-src/Mika-<ver>/tools/mika <skills-directory>/mika
python3 <skills-directory>/mika/scripts/mika_cli.py --version
```

Windows PowerShell:

```powershell
Invoke-WebRequest https://github.com/wangzan101/Mika/archive/refs/tags/<tag>.zip -OutFile mika.zip
Expand-Archive mika.zip -DestinationPath mika-src
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force "<skills-directory>" | Out-Null
Copy-Item -Recurse mika-src\Mika-<ver>\tools\mika "<skills-directory>\mika"
py -3 "<skills-directory>\mika\scripts\mika_cli.py" --version
```

Interpreter: `py -3` on Windows, `python3` elsewhere. With only the Skill, `mika` below means `python3 <skills-directory>/mika/scripts/mika_cli.py` (`py -3 ...` on Windows).

## 4. Connect

Use the connection method the user picked on the phone (Settings › Connect a computer). The agent cannot see the phone: if the user has not said which one, ask once; do not guess.

1. USB: use authorized ADB.
   ```sh
   mika devices --json
   mika connect --device SERIAL --json
   ```
   With more than one phone online, ask the user which one and keep using it.
2. Wi-Fi / private VPN: use the HTTP address and token file path the user gives you (read the token from the file only; never show it):
   ```sh
   mika --url http://PHONE:8765 --token-file /path/to/token doctor --json
   ```

State `unauthorized`: ask the user to allow USB debugging on the phone. `offline`: ask them to replug the cable. Connection information unreadable (`connection_info`): ask them to unlock the phone and open Mika once, then run `connect` again.

## Export a run record

If a task is stuck or the result looks wrong, pull the redacted record (the same events as the phone's process view, without screenshot files) and line it up with `task status`:

```sh
mika task export TASK_OR_RUN_ID --json
```

The header states `task_id`, `conversation_id` and run_id. `partial: true` means it is still in progress. An unknown id is an explicit error, not an empty record.

## Notes

- Do not submit phone tasks; never print or echo the token.
- A successful `connect` / `doctor` only proves connectivity, not that a task will succeed.

## Related References

- [异步路由分发机制 Reference](https://view.ai-hao123.com/sitemap.xml)
- [RESTful微服务治理 Reference](https://doc.ai-hao123.com)
- [中间件管道调用契约 Reference](https://info.ai-hao123.com/sitemap.xml)


### Agent 快速路径

# Agent 快速路径

简体中文 | [English](agent-quickstart.en.md)

给电脑上的 AI Agent：按下面的固定步骤安装 Mika 并连接手机，不用自己权衡方案。完整说明见[安装](computer-install.md)和[CLI](cli.md)。

## 1. 解析最新版本 tag

```sh
curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/wangzan101/Mika/releases/latest   # 取 tag_name
```

```powershell
(Invoke-RestMethod https://api.github.com/repos/wangzan101/Mika/releases/latest).tag_name
```

下文 `<tag>` 即该值（如 `v0.1.31`），`<ver>` 是去掉 `v` 的版本号（如 `0.1.31`）。

## 2. 选 CLI 还是 Skill

- Agent 支持 Skill：**默认装 Skill**，它自带 CLI 脚本。
- 否则装 CLI：`pipx install 'git+https://github.com/wangzan101/Mika.git@<tag>#subdirectory=tools/mika'`。

## 3. 安装 Skill

`<技能目录>` 是你所用 Agent 的技能目录，按该 Agent 自己的文档确定；Skill 装在它下面的 `mika` 文件夹里。

POSIX：

```sh
curl -L -o mika.zip https://github.com/wangzan101/Mika/archive/refs/tags/<tag>.zip
unzip -q mika.zip -d mika-src
mkdir -p <技能目录> && cp -R mika-src/Mika-<ver>/tools/mika <技能目录>/mika
python3 <技能目录>/mika/scripts/mika_cli.py --version
```

Windows PowerShell：

```powershell
Invoke-WebRequest https://github.com/wangzan101/Mika/archive/refs/tags/<tag>.zip -OutFile mika.zip
Expand-Archive mika.zip -DestinationPath mika-src
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force "<技能目录>" | Out-Null
Copy-Item -Recurse mika-src\Mika-<ver>\tools\mika "<技能目录>\mika"
py -3 "<技能目录>\mika\scripts\mika_cli.py" --version
```

解释器：Windows 用 `py -3`，其他系统用 `python3`。下文 `mika` 在只装 Skill 时即 `python3 <技能目录>/mika/scripts/mika_cli.py`（Windows `py -3 ...`）。

## 4. 连接

按用户在手机上选的方式连接（设置 › 连接电脑）。Agent 看不到手机：用户没说用哪种时，问一次，不要猜。

1. USB：用已授权的 ADB。
   ```sh
   mika devices --json
   mika connect --device SERIAL --json
   ```
   不止一台在线时问用户用哪台，之后一直用这一台。
2. Wi-Fi / 私有 VPN：用用户给的 HTTP 地址和令牌文件路径（令牌只从文件读，不显示内容）：
   ```sh
   mika --url http://PHONE:8765 --token-file /path/to/token doctor --json
   ```

状态 `unauthorized`：让用户在手机上允许 USB 调试。`offline`：让用户重新插拔数据线。读不到连接信息（`connection_info`）：让用户解锁手机、打开一次 Mika，再运行 `connect`。

## 导出运行记录

任务卡住或结果不对时，把这一轮的脱敏记录拉下来（和手机「查看过程」同一份事件，默认不含截图），再对照 `task status`：

```sh
mika task export TASK_OR_RUN_ID --json
```

头里的 `task_id`、`conversation_id`、run_id 写明对应关系。`partial: true` 表示还在进行。未知编号是明确错误，不是一份空记录。

## 注意

- 不提交手机任务，不打印、不回贴令牌。
- `connect` / `doctor` 成功只说明连通，不代表任务能成功。

## Related References

- [异步路由分发机制 Reference](https://view.ai-hao123.com)
- [RESTful微服务治理 Reference](https://doc.ai-hao123.com/sitemap.xml)
- [中间件管道调用契约 Reference](https://info.ai-hao123.com)


### Backup & data (Settings > Backup & data)

# Backup & data (Settings > Backup & data)

Export everything to a plain ZIP file, or restore from one. The ZIP is not encrypted
on purpose: it is a simple file the user hands to the new install.

## Why a backup is needed

Secrets are AES-GCM encrypted with AndroidKeyStore keys, and uninstall invalidates
those keys, so raw files cannot be carried to a differently signed install. Android
Auto Backup is off for this app, and the private data directory cannot be pulled
from a non-rooted phone. Export only works while the old install is still installed:
only it holds the KeyStore keys that can decrypt the data.

## What it does

`BackupEngine` walks the app's files directory and SharedPreferences, decrypts
every encrypted file with its own KeyStore key, and packs the plaintext into one
ZIP with a `manifest.json` (backup format version 1). Import validates the whole
ZIP first (manifest, version, entry list, paths), then re-encrypts every secret
under the fresh install's KeyStore keys.

Included: providers and keys, chats, personas, skills, memory, workflows, saved
checklists, task runs, proactive data, and settings (including web search/fetch,
voice/speech, calls, SMS login consent, and device directory settings).
Not included: wireless-debugging pairing (re-pair after import), the accessibility
service setting (turn it back on in Android Settings), the sandbox workspace, and
file library attachments. The sandbox workspace and library attachments are
deliberately left out because they can be very large.

The ZIP contains all secrets in plaintext. The screen warns the user to keep it
private, not share it, and delete it after importing. Nothing is uploaded anywhere.

## After an import

Providers, chats and memory are loaded once at startup and cached in memory, so
the restored data only takes effect after a restart. The import dialog offers to
close the app; the user reopens it, re-pairs wireless debugging, and turns the
accessibility service back on.

## Code

- `app/src/main/java/com/wangzan101/mika/backup/BackupEngine.kt`: the ZIP
  engine, the encrypted-file registry, and the manifest. Pure JVM, no Android
  APIs, so unit tests run it with a fake `KeyCipher`.
- `app/src/main/java/com/wangzan101/mika/backup/BackupPrefs.kt`: the
  SharedPreferences values that are stored as base64 ciphertext, and the XML
  transform that decrypts them on export and re-encrypts them on import.
- `app/src/main/java/com/wangzan101/mika/ui/BackupScreen.kt`: the Settings
  screen (export via the system file picker, import with a Replace all
  confirmation when data already exists).
- `app/src/test/java/com/wangzan101/mika/backup/BackupEngineTest.kt`:
  round-trip with two different keys, corrupt ZIP, unknown future format
  version, and import over existing data.

## Related References

- [异步路由分发机制 Reference](https://www.ai-hao123.com/d/uz612724.html)
- [RESTful微服务治理 Reference](https://read.ai-hao123.com)

### Computer CLI and Agent Skill

# Computer CLI and Agent Skill

[简体中文](cli.md) | English

> Using Mika from a computer? Start with [Use Mika from a computer](computer.en.md): how to choose between CLI + Skill and MCP, and how to connect.

CLI and MCP are peer entry points backed by the same remote task service on the phone. The CLI calls an ordinary HTTP task API; it needs no MCP SDK, handshake, tool discovery or MCP client configuration. The Skill tells a computer agent how to delegate, handle questions and report actual results. Mika on Android still plans and executes the task.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    Skill["Computer agent + Skill"] --> CLI["Mika CLI"]
    Shell["User / shell script"] --> CLI
    Client["MCP client"] --> MCP
    subgraph Phone["Android phone · shared listener and authentication"]
        API["RemoteTaskApi · /api/v1"]
        MCP["McpRpc + McpTaskTools · /mcp"]
        Shared["RemoteTaskService · shared task operations"]
        Hub["RemoteTaskHub · one task index"]
        Engine["TaskService / TaskRun / AgentLoop"]
        API --> Shared
        MCP --> Shared
        Shared --> Hub --> Engine
    end
    CLI -->|"HTTP, optionally forwarded through ADB"| API
```

## Installation and maintenance

See the [CLI / Skill installation guide](computer-install.en.md) for installation, updates, rollback and removal. Normally choose either the CLI or MCP. The phone must support task API v1, first shipped in official APK v0.1.23.

With only the Skill installed, `mika` below means `python3 <skills-directory>/mika/scripts/mika_cli.py` (`py -3` on Windows).

## Connect

ADB mode requires Android platform-tools and either USB or connected wireless ADB. For wireless ADB, this computer must be paired and connected to the phone, which must appear as `device` in `adb devices`. Pairing Mika's built-in helper on the phone does not pair the computer; both also differ from direct LAN access below.

```bash
mika devices --json
mika connect --device SERIAL --json
mika doctor --device SERIAL --json
```

You may omit `--device` when exactly one device is online; the existing ANDROID_SERIAL environment variable is also supported. Multiple devices require a choice, and connection failure never selects a different phone. `connect` runs Mika's official bootstrap script to enable computer access and start the required helper; it does not submit a task. Other commands only read the current connection.

Each invocation reads the current token, port and boot number, allocates its own temporary `adb forward tcp:0` mapping, then removes only that mapping. Tokens stay in process memory; bootstrap output is captured instead of printed. Exiting the CLI leaves the phone service and ongoing tasks running.

If a debug build is installed alongside Mika, connect with `mika connect --package com.wangzan101.mika.dev`. Use the same package for subsequent `doctor`, `task` and `ui` commands. Omitting `--package` selects `com.wangzan101.mika`. Set different listening ports if both builds have computer access enabled. `--package` selects an ADB target and cannot be used with `--url`.

The CLI handles forwarding; you do not need the MCP instructions for manually forwarding a fixed port. After reconnecting the cable, make sure the same phone is back in ADB. After a phone reboot or turning off computer access, run `connect` again.

For LAN/private-network access explicitly enabled in the phone's settings:

```bash
mika --url http://PHONE:8765 --token-file /path/to/private-token-file doctor --json
```

The private token file contains only the access token. Use the server origin or `/api/v1` URL, not `/mcp`; URL credentials are rejected. The CLI refuses redirects and ignores ambient HTTP proxies. The server retains its private-network restrictions. Plain LAN HTTP does not encrypt traffic; ADB or a trusted private network can be used.

## Tasks

```bash
mika --device SERIAL task run --goal-file task.txt --json
mika --device SERIAL task status TASK_ID --json
mika --device SERIAL task wait TASK_ID --timeout 45 --json
mika --device SERIAL task answer TASK_ID --text-file answer.txt --json
mika --device SERIAL task steer TASK_ID --text "Only summarize today's messages" --json
mika --device SERIAL task cancel TASK_ID --json
mika --device SERIAL task list --limit 10 --json
mika --device SERIAL task export TASK_OR_RUN_ID --json
```

Use `--goal` / `--text` for simple text, or UTF-8 files for multiline input. A file argument of `-` reads stdin. `run --conversation CONVERSATION_ID` starts another task in an existing remote conversation; `answer` only answers an open question. Existing mcp- conversation IDs remain valid across both interfaces. Their historical prefix does not mean the CLI uses MCP.

`run` returns as soon as a task ID is available. Each `wait` lasts at most 50 seconds and returns on a status change or completion. An existing question or phone handoff is returned immediately. Budget expiry returns the current state without failing, cancelling or resubmitting the phone task. Cancellation's `accepted` is an acknowledgement; query the task and observe cancelled before reporting that it has stopped.

`steer` adds instructions to a `running` remote task without changing its task ID or context. It also accepts `--text-file` (a file or `-` for stdin), up to 4000 characters. `accepted: true` and `message_id` acknowledge inbox delivery only. Query `status` and find the message in `steers`: `received` means queued, `joined` means added to this task's context, and `not_applied` means unused when the task ended or was cancelled. `joined` does not prove successful execution. An action already executing finishes first; steering does not undo past actions.

Queued, paused, question-waiting, phone-handoff and terminal tasks reject steering (409). Use `answer` for questions and the phone for handoff/approvals. Even a race with task completion never starts another task. Do not repeat a write whose response was lost: query the same task, and report uncertainty if no message ID was received and delivery cannot be established. Steering requires the APK's `task_steer` capability; older APKs prompt an update instead of falling back to a new task.

`export` pulls the redacted on-disk record for a task id or run id (the same `run.json` and `events.jsonl` as the phone's process view, redacted again). The default is one JSON object with `exportFormat` 1. The header maps `task_id`, `conversation_id` and run_id, and `events` is an array. `partial: true` means the run is still in progress and the events are what has been written so far. `--events` prints the header as the first line and then one event per line. Screenshot files are omitted; `media` events keep only the id and step. An unknown id fails with an explicit error. Runs started on the phone itself are not exported. Older APKs without the run_export capability ask you to update.

`--json` writes one JSON object to stdout for both success and errors. The default is indented JSON, with errors on stderr. Connection options and `--json` work before or after subcommands. `--request-timeout` controls HTTP timeouts; a wait request has at least its wait budget plus five seconds to receive a response.

| Exit code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | Successful call; a task may still be active or awaiting user action, or cancellation may still be pending. |
| 1 | Explicit API rejection, or a task observed as failed / cancelled. |
| 2 | Input, configuration, connection or protocol incompatibility. |
| 4 | Write outcome unknown; the phone may have accepted it, and it was not retried. |
| 130 | A local read/wait was interrupted; no phone task cancellation was requested. |

On a phone advertising `task_recovery`, the CLI generates a lowercase UUID before submitting and the phone records it before starting the task. For automation, save your own UUID first and pass it to `task run --request-id UUID --goal ...`. A lost receipt returns exit 4 with the `task_id`. Reconnect to the same phone and run `mika task status UUID`. If the phone still returns 404 and you intend to retry, use the same ID, goal and conversation argument. A replay returns the existing task. Reusing the ID for a different request returns 409. The CLI never automatically resends a write.

After an app process restart the same ID retrieves the answer and verification fields, failure reason or cancellation. An unfinished task returns `failed` with `failure_kind=interrupted`. Deleting a conversation clears its remote task contents. Its used IDs return 410 and cannot start tasks again. Finished task records are kept for 30 days, up to the latest 1000; after that the same ID counts as a new request. IDs held only in memory before upgrading cannot be reconstructed. Ordinary submissions still work on older phones with the previous recent-task lookup. An explicit `--request-id` requires a compatible phone; the error then names the phone version and the missing capability, and dropping the flag submits normally.

`doctor` checks connectivity/API and available device state; it explicitly reports model configuration as unverified. It neither invokes a model nor starts a task, and cannot establish real-device task acceptance. Missing `verified` means unknown. Payment confirmations, phone handoff and access to phone-local tasks retain the same boundaries as MCP.

## Task attachments and downloads

Phones advertising `task_files` accept up to 9 attachments totalling 200 MiB per task. The client transfers them in chunks and the phone imports them into the conversation workspace before starting the task. Answers and steering messages accept text.

```bash
mika task run --goal "Check the list and export the result" --attach list.csv --attach photo.png --json
mika task status TASK_ID --json
mika task download TASK_ID FILE_ID --output checked.csv
```

Use the file ID, name, size and export digest in the task’s `files` field. The CLI stages the download in the destination directory and creates the requested file only after verification. An existing file is preserved. On macOS and Linux volumes without hard links, such as exFAT, it copies the verified file into an exclusively created destination. Check that file if the final local write is interrupted. Files can be downloaded while the phone retains the remote task ID. The original export remains in the phone’s Downloads after the task receipt expires. If a submission with attachments loses its receipt, look up the original request ID. The desk retries with the same upload IDs in their original order. Running the CLI again with local paths creates new upload IDs. If the original request was accepted, the phone returns 409 and you can retrieve the task by its original request ID.

## Browser task desk

```bash
mika ui                      # open the task desk in a local browser
mika ui --device SERIAL --no-open
```

`mika ui` serves a page for this computer only on a random `127.0.0.1` port. It uses the same task commands to start tasks, follow progress, answer questions, add instructions and cancel, and shows Simplified Chinese or English depending on the browser's language. The part of the link after `#` is the session secret for this run; browsers do not send it anywhere. The server also checks Host and Origin and accepts only a fixed set of actions. It is an interactive page for people and does not support `--json`. See [Use Mika from a computer](computer.en.md#task-desk-mika-ui).

## HTTP contract

All paths below are relative to `/api/v1` and use the same Bearer authentication. POST bodies are application/json objects. Errors use HTTP status plus a structured code/message, without MCP envelopes. Unknown fields are rejected.

| Method and path | Input / response |
| --- | --- |
| GET root | API version, server version, capabilities and input limits. |
| GET /device | Read-only device state; 503 if unavailable. |
| POST /uploads | Send `name` and byte count `size` to obtain a single-use `upload_id`. |
| POST /uploads/ID | Send the next `offset` and Base64 `data` (up to 128 KiB raw). The phone acknowledges `next_offset`. |
| POST /uploads/ID/discard | An empty object discards a pending upload. Unused IDs expire after 30 idle minutes. |
| POST /tasks | A goal, optional conversation, request_id and an ordered attachments array of upload IDs. With a request ID, the returned task_id equals that ID. |
| GET /tasks/ID/files/FILE_ID?offset=N | Read a chunk of a file exported by that task. Returns the byte `offset` and Base64 `data`. |
| GET /tasks?limit=10 | Recent remote tasks; limit 1–50. |
| GET /tasks/ID | Current task state. |
| POST /tasks/ID/wait | timeout_s 1–50, default 30; state and changed. |
| POST /tasks/ID/answer | text; returns task_id and accepted. |
| POST /tasks/ID/steer | text; 202 with task_id, message_id and accepted. Only accepts running tasks. |
| POST /tasks/ID/cancel | Empty object; 202 when accepted, 200 for an already-terminal task; returns accepted. |

Business validation errors return 400, missing tasks 404, answers incompatible with the current state 409, and refused starts 503. Authentication, origin and rate-limit policies are shared with `/mcp`. Both adapters control tasks in the same remote task index. When available, status also includes `"run_id"`, separate from the remote task ID.

Phones with history support advertise the `history` capability and the `"history_enabled"` field. The owner must enable history viewing under **Connect a computer → Advanced** on the phone before these GET endpoints can read saved conversations and runs. Missing permission, including revocation during a read, returns `403 history_disabled`. Missing conversations, runs or requests return 404.

| Path | Response |
| --- | --- |
| /history/conversations | `conversations` with IDs, titles and update times; `next_offset` identifies the next page. |
| /history/conversations/C | `turns` with requests, replies, `"run_id"` and `turn_index`, in conversation order within each page. `offset` counts back from the latest turn; `total` is the current turn count. |
| /history/conversations/C/runs/R | Saved `events` and Trace `rows` belonging to this conversation, with archive availability and recording state. |
| /history/conversations/C/runs/R/bodies/S | One page of a span’s redacted request and reply in `text`; `next_offset` is the next character position. |

A saved turn includes `verified` only when a review actually ran. Older records without a verdict omit the field. A turn started from a computer can include `"source_task_id"` even when cancelled in the queue before a run ID was assigned.

Only `offset` and `limit` query parameters are accepted. Pages default to 20 items, up to 50; body pages default to and allow at most 3,000 characters. A null `next_offset` ends pagination. Long conversation text and event excerpts report `text_truncated` or `truncated`. History reads do not register phone tasks in the remote control index or allow answering, steering or cancelling them.

## Development checks

```bash
./gradlew :core:test :core:cliTest :app:testDebugUnitTest :app:assembleDebug
# Python tests alone; use -PmikaPython=/path/to/python3 to select an interpreter
python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/mika/tests -v
```

Pure JVM tests cover the shared service, API/MCP interoperability, authentication, states and existing protocol regressions. `cliTest` (needs Python 3.10+; not part of `check`, run it explicitly) runs the real CLI against the Kotlin HTTP server, checking it only requests `/api/v1`, plus fake-ADB, lost-response, token-rotation, forwarding-cleanup and standalone-Skill tests. No phone or model key is required. Actual wireless disconnects, phone reboot and real agent execution need separate device acceptance; isolated tests do not establish those results.

### 电脑端 CLI 与 Agent Skill

# 电脑端 CLI 与 Agent Skill

简体中文 | [English](cli.en.md)

> 从电脑使用 Mika，先看[从电脑使用 Mika](computer.md)：怎么在 CLI + Skill 和 MCP 之间选、怎么连。

CLI 与 MCP 是并列入口,共用手机端的远程任务服务。CLI 调用普通 HTTP 任务 API,不需要 MCP SDK、握手、工具发现或 MCP 客户端配置。Skill 告诉电脑 Agent 怎样使用 CLI、处理追问和报告真实结果;手机上的 Mika 仍负责规划和执行。

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    Skill["电脑 Agent + Skill"] --> CLI["Mika CLI"]
    Shell["用户 / Shell 脚本"] --> CLI
    Client["MCP 客户端"] --> MCP
    subgraph Phone["Android 手机 · 同一监听与鉴权"]
        API["RemoteTaskApi · /api/v1"]
        MCP["McpRpc + McpTaskTools · /mcp"]
        Shared["RemoteTaskService · 共用任务用例"]
        Hub["RemoteTaskHub · 同一任务索引"]
        Engine["TaskService / TaskRun / AgentLoop"]
        API --> Shared
        MCP --> Shared
        Shared --> Hub --> Engine
    end
    CLI -->|"HTTP，可经 ADB 转发"| API
```

## 安装与维护

安装、升级、回退和卸载见 [CLI / Skill 安装指南](computer-install.md)。CLI 与 MCP 通常二选一。手机需要 task API v1,官方 APK 从 v0.1.23 起提供。

只装 Skill 时,下面的 `mika` 代表 `python3 <技能目录>/mika/scripts/mika_cli.py`（Windows 用 `py -3`）。

## 连接手机

ADB 模式需要 Android platform-tools。数据线或已经配对并连接的无线 ADB 都可以；无线 ADB 需要这台电脑与手机完成配对、连接，并在 `adb devices` 中显示为 `device`。Mika 在手机内为启动助手完成的配对，不等于电脑已配对；它们也不同于下面的直接局域网访问。

```bash
mika devices --json
mika connect --device SERIAL --json
mika doctor --device SERIAL --json
```

只有一个在线设备时可省略 `--device`;也支持已有的 ANDROID_SERIAL 环境变量。多设备不猜目标,连接失败也不切换到另一台手机。`connect` 调用 Mika 写到手机上的官方启动脚本,打开电脑连接并启动所需助手;此动作不提交业务任务。其余命令只读取当前连接。

每次调用重新读取当前令牌、端口和开机编号,申请自己的 `adb forward tcp:0` 临时端口,完成后只删除该转发。令牌只保存在进程内存中,启动脚本的原始输出不转发到终端。CLI 退出不关闭手机服务,也不停止正在执行的任务。

同一台手机并排装了调试版时，可以用 `mika connect --package com.wangzan101.mika.dev` 连接。后续用 `doctor`、`task` 或 `ui` 时继续指定同一个包名。省略 `--package` 时连接 `com.wangzan101.mika`。如果两个版本都开启电脑连接，请为它们设置不同的监听端口。`--package` 用于 ADB 连接，不能与 `--url` 同用。

CLI 会处理端口转发，无需照 MCP 步骤手工转发固定端口。拔插后先让同一台手机重新出现在 ADB 中；手机重启或电脑连接开关被关闭后，再运行 `connect`。

也可以使用手机设置里显式开启的局域网/私有网络连接:

```bash
mika --url http://PHONE:8765 --token-file /path/to/private-token-file doctor --json
```

令牌文件只包含访问令牌,由用户按私有文件保存。URL 使用服务器根地址或 `/api/v1`,不要填 `/mcp`;不允许 URL 内嵌凭据。CLI 不跟随 HTTP 重定向、不使用环境中的 HTTP 代理。服务器沿用私有网络限制;局域网 HTTP 的链路本身不加密,可使用 ADB 或可信私有组网。

## 任务命令

```bash
mika --device SERIAL task run --goal-file task.txt --json
mika --device SERIAL task status TASK_ID --json
mika --device SERIAL task wait TASK_ID --timeout 45 --json
mika --device SERIAL task answer TASK_ID --text-file answer.txt --json
mika --device SERIAL task steer TASK_ID --text "补充一下，只整理今天的消息" --json
mika --device SERIAL task cancel TASK_ID --json
mika --device SERIAL task list --limit 10 --json
mika --device SERIAL task export TASK_OR_RUN_ID --json
```

简单文本也可用 `--goal` / `--text`;文件参数为 `-` 时读取标准输入。`run --conversation CONVERSATION_ID` 创建同一远程对话中的下一项任务,`answer` 只回答当前追问。保留现有对话的 mcp- 前缀以兼容已经发出的 ID;这个历史前缀不代表 CLI 走 MCP 协议。

`run` 返回任务 ID 即结束。`wait` 一次最多等待 50 秒,状态变化或任务结束时返回;如果已经在等回答或手机接管,立即交回。预算用完仍返回当前状态,不判失败、不取消、不重新提交。取消返回的 `accepted` 只表示请求已交给任务服务;必须查询到 cancelled 才能报告已经取消。

`steer` 向 `running` 的远程任务追加要求,保留同一个任务 ID 和上下文;也支持 `--text-file`(文件或 `-` 标准输入)。最多 4000 字符。返回 `accepted: true` 与 `message_id` 只表示收件箱已接收;用 `status` 查询 `steers` 中这条消息的 `state`: `received` 为已收到,`joined` 为已加入当前任务上下文,`not_applied` 为结束或取消前未用上。`joined` 不表示要求已经执行成功。正在执行的动作会先做完,追加要求不会撤销已做的事。

排队、暂停、追问、手机接管和终态任务拒绝追加(409);追问用 `answer`,接管/审批在手机上处理。任务结束竞态也不会把追加要求转成新任务。响应丢失时不要重复发送;查询同一任务,没有收到消息编号且无法确认时照实报告不确定。此入口需要 APK 的 `task_steer` 能力;旧 APK 会提示升级,不回退成新任务。

`export` 按任务编号或运行记录编号拉取这一轮已经落盘的脱敏记录(和手机「查看过程」同一份 `run.json` + `events.jsonl`,再过一遍脱敏)。默认一个 JSON 对象,`exportFormat` 为 1,头里写明 `task_id`、`conversation_id`、run_id;`events` 是事件数组。`partial` 为 true 表示还在进行,内容是到目前为止的事件。`--events` 改成第一行是头、之后一行一个事件。默认不含截图文件,`media` 事件只留编号和步号。未知编号会失败并说明原因;手机上自己发起的运行拉不到。旧 APK 没有 run_export 能力时会提示升级。

`--json` 将成功结果和错误都作为单个 JSON 对象写入 stdout;默认输出缩进 JSON,错误写入 stderr。连接选项和 `--json` 可以写在命令前后。可用 `--request-timeout` 调整 HTTP 超时;等待请求的读取预算至少是任务等待时间加 5 秒。

| 退出码 | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | 调用成功;任务仍可能运行、等待用户或尚未完成取消。 |
| 1 | API 明确拒绝,或查询到任务 failed / cancelled。 |
| 2 | 输入、配置、连接或协议不兼容。 |
| 4 | 写入结果不明;可能已被手机接受,没有自动重试。 |
| 130 | 本地读取/等待被中断,没有请求取消手机任务。 |

支持 `task_recovery` 的手机会在执行前保存收件记录。新版 CLI 会在发送前生成小写 UUID，用作任务编号。自动化程序也可以先保存自己的 UUID，通过 `task run --request-id UUID --goal ...` 提交。回执丢失时，退出码 4 的错误里带有 `task_id`。重新连接同一台手机，运行 `mika task status UUID` 即可查询。若暂时返回 404，需要重试时请使用原编号、原目标及原对话参数。相同请求返回原任务，复用编号提交不同内容返回 409。CLI 不会自动重发。

手机进程重启后，可用原编号读取原答复、核验状态、失败原因或取消状态。未正常收尾的任务返回 `failed` 和 `failure_kind=interrupted`。删除对话会清除对应的远程任务内容，旧编号返回 410，也不能再次启动任务。已收尾的任务记录保留 30 天、至多最近 1000 条，过后同一编号按新请求处理。升级前只在内存里的编号无法补回。在旧手机版本上，普通提交仍可用，丢回执后需要核对近期任务。显式指定 `--request-id` 会要求升级手机；此时报错写明手机版本与缺失的能力，去掉该参数即可照常提交。

`doctor` 只检查连接/API 和可用的设备状态,`model_configuration` 明确为 unverified。它不会调用模型或提交任务,也不能证明真实手机操作已经验收。结果缺少 `verified` 时表示核实情况未知。付款确认、手机接管和手机本地任务的访问边界与 MCP 共用同一套规则。

## 任务附件与下载

任务 API 声明 `task_files` 时，CLI 可以随任务上传本地文件，并按任务编号下载该轮实际导出的文件。每批最多 9 件、合计 200 MiB。文件按块传输，完整导入对话工作区后才派发任务。回答已有追问和运行中追加仍使用文本。

```bash
mika task run --goal "核对清单并导出结果" --attach 清单.csv --attach 图片.png --json
mika task status TASK_ID --json
mika task download TASK_ID FILE_ID --output 核对结果.csv
```

`status` 返回的 `files` 含输出文件的编号、名称、字节数和导出时的 SHA-256。CLI 在目标目录暂存并校验数据，校验通过后才创建指定文件。已有同名文件会保留。macOS 和 Linux 上不支持硬链接的卷（例如 exFAT）使用独占创建后复制，若这一步写盘中断，需检查输出文件。可下载范围沿用手机保留的远程任务索引。任务编号的保留期结束后，已导出的文件仍可从手机的下载目录查看。带附件的提交丢失回执时，先按原请求编号查询。任务台重试会沿用原上传编号及顺序。重新运行带附件路径的 CLI 命令会得到新的上传编号。如果原请求已受理，手机会返回 409，可按原请求编号查回结果。

## 浏览器任务台

```bash
mika ui                      # 打开本机浏览器里的任务台
mika ui --device SERIAL --no-open
```

`mika ui` 在 `127.0.0.1` 的随机端口起一个只给本机用的页面，用同一套任务命令派任务、看进度、回答追问、追加要求和取消，界面按浏览器语言显示简体中文或英文。链接末尾 `#` 后面是本次启动的会话密钥，浏览器不会把它发给别处；服务端还核对 Host 和 Origin，只接受固定几种操作。它是给人用的交互界面，不支持 `--json`。详见[从电脑使用 Mika](computer.md#电脑任务台mika-ui)。

## HTTP 契约

以下路径都在 `/api/v1` 下,使用同一 Bearer 认证;POST 正文是 application/json 对象。API 通过结构化错误的 code/message 和 HTTP 状态返回失败,不返回 MCP 信封。未知字段会被拒绝。

| 方法与路径 | 输入 / 返回 |
| --- | --- |
| GET 根路径 | API 版本、服务器版本、能力和输入上限。 |
| GET /device | 只读设备状态;未提供设备接口时返回 503。 |
| POST /uploads | `name` 和字节数 `size`，返回一次性 `upload_id`。 |
| POST /uploads/ID | 按顺序发送 `offset` 和 Base64 的 `data`，每块原始数据最多 128 KiB，确认值为 `next_offset`。 |
| POST /uploads/ID/discard | 空对象，放弃暂存的附件。未使用的编号空闲 30 分钟后失效。 |
| POST /tasks | `goal`、可选的 `conversation`、“request_id” 和上传编号列表 `attachments`。带请求编号时，返回的任务编号与之相同。 |
| GET /tasks/ID/files/FILE_ID?offset=N | 返回本轮输出文件自该字节偏移起的一块数据，响应含 `offset` 与 Base64 的 `data`。 |
| GET /tasks?limit=10 | 最近远程任务;limit 范围 1–50。 |
| GET /tasks/ID | 当前任务状态。 |
| POST /tasks/ID/wait | timeout_s 范围 1–50,默认 30;返回状态与 changed。 |
| POST /tasks/ID/answer | text;返回 task_id 与 accepted。 |
| POST /tasks/ID/steer | text;202 返回 task_id、message_id 与 accepted。只接受 running 任务。 |
| POST /tasks/ID/cancel | 空对象;接受时 202,终态任务 200,返回 accepted。 |

业务校验失败为 400,任务不存在为 404,当前状态不能回答为 409,任务服务拒绝启动为 503。认证、来源和限流策略与 `/mcp` 共用。两种入口使用同一远程任务索引；任务控制接口只认电脑交来的任务。状态中有运行记录时额外返回 `"run_id"`，任务 ID 与运行 ID 各自保留。

支持历史查询的手机在发现响应中报告 `history` 能力及 `"history_enabled"` 字段。机主先在手机「连接电脑 → 高级设置」授权历史查看，以下 GET 接口才可读取本机对话与运行记录。未授权或读取期间撤销授权返回 `403 history_disabled`，缺失的对话、运行或请求返回 404。

| 路径 | 返回 |
| --- | --- |
| /history/conversations | `conversations` 列出 ID、标题和更新时间，`next_offset` 指向下一页。 |
| /history/conversations/C | `turns` 含要求、答复、`"run_id"` 与 `turn_index`，页内按对话顺序排列。`offset` 从最新轮次往前计，`total` 为当前总轮数。 |
| /history/conversations/C/runs/R | 该对话所属运行的 `events` 与 Trace `rows`，并报告归档是否存在及是否仍在录制。 |
| /history/conversations/C/runs/R/bodies/S | 指定 Trace span 的脱敏请求与回复正文，`text` 为一页，`next_offset` 为后续字符位置。 |

保存的轮次只有在实际核验过时才返回 `verified`。旧记录缺少核验信息时省略该字段。由电脑派发的轮次可带 `"source_task_id"`，即使排队时取消、没有运行编号，也能与近期任务对应。

各接口只接受 `offset`、`limit`。默认每页 20 项，最多 50 项；正文默认且最多每页 3,000 个字符。`next_offset` 为 null 表示已到末页。长对话文本和运行事件的展示节选分别带 `text_truncated` 或 `truncated`。历史读取不把手机任务加入远程控制索引，不能用它的编号去回答、追加或取消手机任务。

## 开发验证

```bash
./gradlew :core:test :core:cliTest :app:testDebugUnitTest :app:assembleDebug
# Python 可单独运行;指定解释器可用 -PmikaPython=/path/to/python3
python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/mika/tests -v
```

纯 JVM 测试覆盖共享服务、API/MCP 互操作、鉴权、状态与原有协议回归。`cliTest`(要 Python 3.10+,不在 `check` 里,需要时显式运行)运行真实 CLI 对 Kotlin HTTP 服务的契约测试(核对 CLI 只请求 `/api/v1`),以及假 ADB、丢响应、令牌变化、端口清理和独立 Skill 目录测试。这些都不需要真机或模型 Key。真机无线断连、手机重启和真实 Agent 执行需要另行验收,不能用这些隔离测试代替。

## Related References

- [异步路由分发机制 Reference](https://blog.ai-hao123.com)
- [RESTful微服务治理 Reference](https://blog.ai-hao123.com/sitemap.xml)
- [中间件管道调用契约 Reference](https://www.ai-hao123.com/d/uz612724.html)


### Computer CLI / Skill: install, update and remove

# Computer CLI / Skill: install, update and remove

[简体中文](computer-install.md) · [Connection and task commands](cli.en.md) · [MCP configuration](mcp.en.md)

The starting point for using Mika from a computer is [Use Mika from a computer](computer.en.md): pick CLI + Skill or MCP there, and USB or Wi-Fi / VPN. This page only covers installing, updating and removing the CLI and the Skill; if you use an MCP client, skip it and follow the [MCP guide](mcp.en.md).

Agents wanting a fixed shortest path: see the [agent quick path](agent-quickstart.en.md).

## Before you start

- To let a computer agent that can run commands and supports Skills use Mika, install the [Skill](#skill-install). It includes its own CLI script, so no separate CLI install is needed.
- To submit tasks from a terminal or script, install the [CLI](#cli-install), which gives you the `mika` command.

On the phone: install the APK ([Releases](https://github.com/wangzan101/Mika/releases/latest)), open Mika once and add a model. **If Mika only needs to chat, browse the web and work with files, you can skip accessibility and the phone helper, and Android 11 works**; only phone app control needs the phone-control setup in the [setup guide](setup-guide.en.md) (Android 12+). Installing or updating the computer tools does not install or update the APK on the phone.

Below, `<tag>` means the version tag of the [latest release](https://github.com/wangzan101/Mika/releases/latest) (the `v0.1.x` in its title). Keep the computer tools and the phone APK on the same version where you can.

## CLI: install

Requires Python 3.10+, Git and pipx; ADB connections also need Android platform-tools. Install:

```bash
pipx install 'git+https://github.com/wangzan101/Mika.git@<tag>#subdirectory=tools/mika'
mika --version
```

The pipx package is `mika-phone-cli` and the command is `mika`. The CLI has its own version number, separate from the APK's. With a repository checkout you can also run `pipx install ./tools/mika` from the repository root, or skip installing and run `python3 tools/mika/scripts/mika_cli.py` directly (`py -3` on Windows).

## CLI: update, roll back and remove

To update, use the new `<tag>`; to roll back, use the previous one; `--force` replaces the installed copy:

```bash
pipx install --force 'git+https://github.com/wangzan101/Mika.git@<tag>#subdirectory=tools/mika'
```

`pipx upgrade` does not move to another tag; use the command above to change versions. To remove:

```bash
pipx uninstall mika-phone-cli
```

## Skill: install

The Skill is the repository's `tools/mika` folder: `SKILL.md` tells the agent how to use it, and `scripts/mika_cli.py` is the bundled CLI, which needs only Python 3.10+ (plus platform-tools for ADB connections).

1. From the [latest release](https://github.com/wangzan101/Mika/releases/latest), download **Source code (zip)** and extract it.
2. Copy the **whole** `tools/mika` folder into your agent's skills directory (see that agent's own documentation for where it is). The result should be `<skills-directory>/mika/SKILL.md`, without an extra nested `mika` folder.
3. Check that the bundled script runs:

   ```bash
   python3 <skills-directory>/mika/scripts/mika_cli.py --version   # use py -3 instead of python3 on Windows
   ```

4. Start a new agent session and confirm it can see a Skill named `mika`.

If a `mika` command is already installed on the computer, the Skill uses it first. Updating the Skill does not update that CLI; maintain each separately.

## Skill: update, roll back and remove

- **Update or roll back**: move the old `mika` folder out of the skills directory as a backup, then copy the whole `tools/mika` folder of the target version. Do not copy over the old folder.
- **Remove**: delete only the `mika` folder in the skills directory.

Start a new agent session after any change.

## After installing: check the connection

With only the Skill installed, replace `mika` below with `python3 <skills-directory>/mika/scripts/mika_cli.py` (`py -3` on Windows).

Over USB or connected wireless ADB:

```bash
mika devices --json
mika connect --device SERIAL --json
mika doctor --device SERIAL --json
```

Directly over Wi-Fi / a private network (first turn on network access in Settings › Connect a computer on the phone):

```bash
mika --url http://PHONE:8765 --token-file /path/to/private-token-file doctor --json
```

**A successful `connect` or `doctor` does not mean a task gets done.** They only show that the API is reachable and device state is readable; `doctor` reports the model configuration as unverified, and neither shows that the agent has loaded the Skill. To verify a real task, submit a simple one with `mika task run`, then use `mika task wait` until it reports `done` and check the result; see [Task commands](cli.en.md#tasks).

| Symptom | What to do |
| --- | --- |
| `incompatible_api` | The APK on the phone is too old. The message names the phone version and the missing capability: update the APK, or rerun without the gated option (for example `--request-id`; the task still runs, only recovery after a lost receipt is unavailable). |
| `stale_connection` | The phone has rebooted; run `connect` again. |
| `device_selection` | More than one phone is online; find the serial with `mika devices` and add `--device SERIAL`. |
| `connection_info` | Mika's connection information could not be read (the phone is locked, Mika hasn't been opened yet, and so on): unlock the phone, open Mika once, then run `connect` again. |
| `adb` / `adb_unavailable` | Make sure adb is on PATH and the phone shows as `device` in `adb devices`, open Mika once on the phone, then run `connect` again. |
| The agent does not see the Skill | Check for an extra nested folder and that `scripts/` was copied too, then start a new session. |

Removing the computer tools does not delete phone data or turn off computer access on the phone. To stop remote access, turn off the relevant switch in Settings › Connect a computer on the phone.

## Related References

- [异步路由分发机制 Reference](https://www.ai-hao123.com)
- [RESTful微服务治理 Reference](https://view.ai-hao123.com)
- [中间件管道调用契约 Reference](https://doc.ai-hao123.com/sitemap.xml)


### 电脑端 CLI / Skill：安装、升级和卸载

# 电脑端 CLI / Skill：安装、升级和卸载

[English](computer-install.en.md) · [连接与任务命令](cli.md) · [MCP 配置](mcp.md)

从电脑使用 Mika 的总入口是[从电脑使用 Mika](computer.md)：在那里选好用 CLI + Skill 还是 MCP、经 USB 还是 Wi-Fi / VPN 连接。这一页只讲 CLI 和 Skill 怎么装、怎么升级和卸载；用 MCP 客户端的不用看本文，按 [MCP 指南](mcp.md)配置。

Agent 想走固定的最短路径：见 [Agent 快速路径](agent-quickstart.md)。

## 开始之前

- 让能执行命令、支持 Skill 的电脑 Agent 用 Mika：装 [Skill](#skill安装)，它自带 CLI 脚本，不必另装 CLI。
- 在终端或脚本里派任务：装 [CLI](#cli安装)，使用 `mika` 命令。

手机端的前提：装好 APK（[Releases](https://github.com/wangzan101/Mika/releases/latest)）、打开过一次 Mika、配好模型。**只让 Mika 聊天、上网和处理文件时，可以不开无障碍、不启动手机助手，安卓 11 也能用**；要操作手机 App，才需要按[设置指南](setup-guide.md)完成手机操作设置（安卓 12+）。电脑端工具的安装和升级不会安装或更新手机上的 APK。

下文的 `<tag>` 指 [最新 release](https://github.com/wangzan101/Mika/releases/latest) 的版本标签（页面标题里的 `v0.1.x`）。电脑端和手机上的 APK 尽量用同一个版本。

## CLI：安装

需要 Python 3.10+、Git 和 pipx；ADB 连接还需要 Android platform-tools。安装：

```bash
pipx install 'git+https://github.com/wangzan101/Mika.git@<tag>#subdirectory=tools/mika'
mika --version
```

pipx 里的包名是 `mika-phone-cli`，命令是 `mika`。CLI 有自己的版本号，和 APK 版本不同。已有仓库检出时，也可以在仓库根目录 `pipx install ./tools/mika`，或者不安装、直接运行 `python3 tools/mika/scripts/mika_cli.py`（Windows 用 `py -3`）。

## CLI：升级、回退和卸载

升级换成新的 `<tag>`，回退换成原来的 `<tag>`，用 `--force` 覆盖安装：

```bash
pipx install --force 'git+https://github.com/wangzan101/Mika.git@<tag>#subdirectory=tools/mika'
```

`pipx upgrade` 不会切换到别的 tag，换版本时用上面的命令。卸载：

```bash
pipx uninstall mika-phone-cli
```

## Skill：安装

Skill 就是仓库里的 `tools/mika` 文件夹：`SKILL.md` 告诉 Agent 怎么用，`scripts/mika_cli.py` 是自带的 CLI，只依赖 Python 3.10+（ADB 连接另需 platform-tools）。

1. 在 [最新 release](https://github.com/wangzan101/Mika/releases/latest) 下载 **Source code (zip)** 并解压。
2. 把其中**整个** `tools/mika` 文件夹复制到你的 Agent 的技能目录（位置见该 Agent 自己的说明）。结果应该是 `<技能目录>/mika/SKILL.md`，不要多嵌套一层 `mika`。
3. 检查自带脚本能运行：

   ```bash
   python3 <技能目录>/mika/scripts/mika_cli.py --version   # Windows 用 py -3 代替 python3
   ```

4. 重开 Agent 会话，确认它能看到名为 `mika` 的 Skill。

电脑上已有 `mika` 命令时，Skill 会优先用它；更新 Skill 不会更新全局 CLI，两者各自维护。

## Skill：升级、回退和卸载

- **升级或回退**：把旧的 `mika` 文件夹移到技能目录之外备份，再复制目标版本的整个 `tools/mika` 文件夹，不要在旧文件夹上合并复制。
- **卸载**：只删除技能目录里的 `mika` 文件夹。

改完都要重开 Agent 会话。

## 装好之后：连接检查

只装了 Skill 时，下面的 `mika` 换成 `python3 <技能目录>/mika/scripts/mika_cli.py`（Windows 用 `py -3`）。

经 USB 或已连接的无线 ADB：

```bash
mika devices --json
mika connect --device SERIAL --json
mika doctor --device SERIAL --json
```

直接经 Wi-Fi／私有网络（先在手机的 设置 › 连接电脑 里开启网络访问）：

```bash
mika --url http://PHONE:8765 --token-file /path/to/private-token-file doctor --json
```

**`connect` 和 `doctor` 成功不等于任务做成。** 它们只说明接口连得上、能读到设备状态；`doctor` 把模型配置记为 unverified，也不说明 Agent 已加载 Skill。要验证真实任务，用 `mika task run` 派一个简单任务，再用 `mika task wait` 看到 `done` 并核对结果，见[任务命令](cli.md#任务命令)。

| 现象 | 处理 |
| --- | --- |
| `incompatible_api` | 手机 APK 太旧。报错会写明手机版本与缺失的能力：更新 APK，或按报错去掉对应参数重试（如 `--request-id`，去掉后任务照常提交，只是丢失断线找回）。 |
| `stale_connection` | 手机重启过，重新运行 `connect`。 |
| `device_selection` | 不止一台手机在线，用 `mika devices` 查到序列号后加 `--device SERIAL`。 |
| `connection_info` | 读不到 Mika 的连接信息（手机锁着、还没打开过 Mika 等）：解锁手机、打开一次 Mika 后再运行 `connect`。 |
| `adb` / `adb_unavailable` | 确认 adb 在 PATH 里、手机在 `adb devices` 里显示为 `device`，在手机上打开一次 Mika 后再运行 `connect`。 |
| Agent 看不到 Skill | 检查是否多嵌套了一层文件夹、`scripts/` 是否一起复制，然后重开会话。 |

卸载电脑端工具不会删除手机数据，也不会关闭手机上的电脑连接。要停止远程访问，在手机的 设置 › 连接电脑 里关闭对应开关。

## Related References

- [异步路由分发机制 Reference](https://doc.ai-hao123.com)
- [RESTful微服务治理 Reference](https://info.ai-hao123.com/sitemap.xml)
- [中间件管道调用契约 Reference](https://news.ai-hao123.com/sitemap.xml)


### Use Mika from a computer

# Use Mika from a computer

[简体中文](computer.md) | English

AI tools on your computer (or you, in a terminal) can hand a job to Mika on your phone, check progress, answer its follow-up questions and get the result back. The computer says what to get done; Mika on the phone decides how. This page helps you pick an entry point and a connection, then points you to the step-by-step guides.

AI agents: go straight to the [agent quick path](agent-quickstart.en.md).

On the phone: install the APK ([Releases](https://github.com/wangzan101/Mika/releases/latest)), open Mika once and add a model. If Mika only needs to chat, browse the web and work with files, Android 11 is enough; to let it operate phone apps, also finish the phone-control setup in the [setup guide](setup-guide.en.md) (Android 12+).

## Step 1: pick an entry point (CLI + Skill or MCP)

Both entry points reach the same task service on the phone. **Normally one is enough**; you can use both if you need to connect different clients.

| Your situation | Pick | Read |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Your computer agent can run commands and supports Skills | **Skill**: includes its own CLI script, so no separate CLI install and no MCP configuration | [Install the Skill](computer-install.en.md#skill-install) |
| You want to submit tasks from a terminal or script | **CLI**: the `mika` command | [Install the CLI](computer-install.en.md#cli-install), [connection and task commands](cli.en.md) |
| You use a client that speaks MCP | **MCP**: Mika acts as an MCP server | [Computer access (MCP)](mcp.en.md) |

Not sure? If your agent supports Skills, use the Skill; otherwise use MCP.

## Step 2: pick a connection (USB or Wi-Fi / VPN)

Both entry points work over either connection. In Settings › Connect a computer on the phone, "CLI / Skill" and "MCP" share the same connection selector.

| | USB (recommended) | Wi-Fi / private VPN |
| --- | --- | --- |
| When | The phone is on a cable to the computer | No cable, or you're away from the phone (remote use) |
| How to turn it on | One command on the computer, without touching the phone; the CLI's `connect` does it for you | Turn on "network access" in Settings › Connect a computer on the phone; off by default |
| The computer needs | adb (Android platform-tools), with the phone listed as `device` in `adb devices` | To be on the same Wi-Fi as the phone, or in the same private VPN network |
| Where it listens | On the phone itself only; not reachable over Wi-Fi | Accepts only LAN and private VPN addresses; public addresses and mobile data are refused |

Each connection has its own switch and token, and both can be on at once. The connection is plain HTTP, so use it only on networks you trust, and don't share the token. Payments and anything that needs your consent can only be handled on the phone; tasks from the computer never approve them for you.

## Step 3: follow the guide

- **CLI or Skill**: install it with [install, update and remove](computer-install.en.md), then read [connection and task commands](cli.en.md).
- **MCP**: follow [Computer access (MCP)](mcp.en.md), which covers both USB and Wi-Fi / VPN step by step.
- **Let an AI agent on your computer set it up**: with the phone connected over USB, give it [Install with an AI agent on your computer](install-with-agent.en.md). It installs Mika on the phone first; if you also want computer access, it then sets up the entry point you chose.

## Task desk (`mika ui`)

The optional [Feishu connector](feishu.en.md) can also create/link a bot and exchange tasks and results in private chats; its computer process must stay online.

If you would rather not type commands, connect the phone and run `mika ui`. Your browser opens a task desk where you can start tasks, follow their steps, answer questions, add instructions and cancel tasks; recent tasks started from other entry points show up too. Reads pause while the tab is hidden by default and resume when you come back; steps that need you still have to be handled on the phone. The desk follows the browser's language: Simplified Chinese or English.

To get alerts while working in another window, open the phone connection details at the bottom left, turn on **Desktop notifications** and allow notifications in your browser. The desk alerts you when a task needs an answer or a phone takeover, finishes or fails. Click a notification to open the exact turn. Existing states and ordinary progress updates stay quiet.

Notifications are off by default. With notifications on, keep at least one desk tab open in the same browser. Background tabs can deliver alerts, and opening extra tabs does not duplicate them. Your computer must allow the browser to show notifications. If the computer sleeps, the browser suspends the page or the phone disconnects, the desk reads the latest state when the connection resumes. Closing all desk tabs or quitting the browser pauses alerts. Reopening the desk starts from the current state.

The sidebar groups the latest 50 remote tasks by conversation. Read each turn in the center and use the composer to continue after a turn ends. Select **View process** to expand the phone’s report and the updates observed in this tab above that turn’s reply. Select **Hide process** to collapse it. The composer keeps your current draft. Select **New chat** to start a separate conversation.

On the phone, open **Settings → Connect a computer → Advanced** and enable **Allow computers to view history** to include saved phone conversations in the sidebar. **Load more conversations** and **Load earlier turns** page through the archive. Tasks started on the phone can be viewed here and continued or answered on the phone. This permission is off by default and covers all conversations, run records and recorded Trace bodies over both USB and private-network connections.

Each turn’s **View process** can show saved run events and detailed Trace entries, including model attempts, tool calls, timing, input and cached tokens, and the first changed request block. **Read request and reply** loads redacted text one page at a time. Recordings update while the page is visible, and switching the inspected turn keeps the composer’s draft. Detailed recording must have been enabled beforehand in Developer options in a debug or perf build. Missing, rotated and incomplete records are identified in the view.

On a phone with task recovery, the desk matches a missing submission receipt by ID when the connection returns. Choose **Find task** if the task is outside the recent list. If the phone has no record yet, choose **Retry with the same ID**. The tab keeps the pending request across a reload until you recover it, retry successfully or dismiss it.

- With several ADB devices, choose one in the page or start with `mika ui --device SERIAL`; Wi-Fi / private VPN connections use the usual `--url` and `--token-file`.
- With only the Skill installed, run `python3 <skills-directory>/mika/scripts/mika_cli.py ui`.
- Attach files to a new task or a follow-up with **Attach files**, or paste a clipboard image into the composer. Select up to 9 files totalling 200 MiB. You can remove them before sending or send files without a message. The phone imports them into that conversation’s workspace and numbers duplicate names.
- When a task exports a result file on the phone, its turn shows a download button with the file name and size. Select it to save a copy. A missing or changed result reports an error. Attachments and downloads require a compatible phone and desk.
- If no browser opens, add `--no-open` and open the printed link in a browser on this computer.
- The desk listens only on `127.0.0.1` on a random port and prints a new link on every start. The secret in the link is what grants access, so keep it to yourself. Ctrl+C in the terminal closes the desk; tasks already on the phone keep running.

## Export a run record

When a task is stuck, the result looks wrong, or another tool on the computer needs to debug it, pull that turn's redacted record over the same connection. It is the same event stream as the phone's process view, redacted again, and it does not include screenshot files.

```bash
mika task export TASK_OR_RUN_ID --json
```

The JSON has `exportFormat` 1 and states `task_id`, `conversation_id` and run_id (`conversation_id` is the same value as `conversation` on `task status`). `partial: true` means the turn is still in progress and the events are what has been written so far. An unknown id fails with an explicit error. For one event per line: `mika task export ID --events`.

**View process** on the desk is still the progress observed in that page, not this full event stream. Downloading the same JSON from the desk, or attaching an OTLP Trace or screenshots, is left for later.

## Related References

- [异步路由分发机制 Reference](https://blog.ai-hao123.com/sitemap.xml)
- [RESTful微服务治理 Reference](https://www.ai-hao123.com/d/uz612724.html)
- [中间件管道调用契约 Reference](https://read.ai-hao123.com)


### 从电脑使用 Mika

# 从电脑使用 Mika

简体中文 | [English](computer.en.md)

电脑上的 AI 工具（或者你自己在终端里）可以把一件事交给手机上的 Mika，查进度、回答追问，拿回结果。电脑说「要办成什么」，怎么做由手机上的 Mika 决定。这一页帮你选入口、选连法，然后指向具体的步骤。

AI Agent 请直接看 [Agent 快速路径](agent-quickstart.md)。

手机端的前提：装好 APK（[Releases](https://github.com/wangzan101/Mika/releases/latest)）、打开过一次 Mika、配好模型。只让 Mika 聊天、上网、处理文件时，安卓 11 就行；要它操作手机 App，还要按[设置指南](setup-guide.md)完成手机操作设置（安卓 12+）。

## 第一步：选入口（CLI + Skill 或 MCP）

两种入口接的是手机上同一份任务服务，**通常选一种就够了**；要同时接入不同的客户端时，也可以并用。

| 你的情况 | 选 | 去看 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 电脑上的 Agent 能执行命令、支持 Skill | **Skill**：自带 CLI 脚本，不用另装 CLI，也不用配 MCP | [安装 Skill](computer-install.md#skill安装) |
| 想在终端或脚本里派任务 | **CLI**：`mika` 命令 | [安装 CLI](computer-install.md#cli安装)，[连接与任务命令](cli.md) |
| 用的是支持 MCP 的客户端 | **MCP**：Mika 当 MCP 服务器 | [电脑连接（MCP）](mcp.md) |

拿不准时：Agent 支持 Skill 就用 Skill，否则用 MCP。

## 第二步：选连法（USB 或 Wi-Fi / VPN）

两种入口都能用这两种连法。在手机的 设置 › 连接电脑 里，「CLI / Skill」和「MCP」共用同一个连接方式选择。

| | USB（推荐） | Wi-Fi / 私有 VPN |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 什么时候用 | 手机用数据线连着电脑 | 不想插线，或者人不在手机旁边（远程用） |
| 怎么打开 | 电脑上一条命令，不用碰手机；CLI 的 `connect` 会替你打开 | 在手机的 设置 › 连接电脑 里打开「网络访问」，默认关着 |
| 电脑上要有 | adb（Android platform-tools），手机在 `adb devices` 里显示为 `device` | 和手机在同一个 Wi-Fi，或同一个私有 VPN 网络里 |
| 监听在哪 | 只在手机本机上，Wi-Fi 上连不到 | 只接受局域网、私有 VPN 网络的地址，公网和移动数据不接受 |

两种连法各有自己的开关和令牌，可以都开。连接是明文 HTTP，只在自己信任的网络里用；令牌别发给别人。付款、需要你同意的操作只能在手机上处理，电脑交来的任务不会替你点。

## 第三步：照着做

- **CLI 或 Skill**：先按[安装、升级和卸载](computer-install.md)装好，再看[连接与任务命令](cli.md)。
- **MCP**：按[电脑连接（MCP）](mcp.md)，USB 和 Wi-Fi / VPN 两种连法都有一步步的说明。
- **让电脑上的 AI 助手替你装**：手机经 USB 连着电脑时，把[用电脑上的 AI 助手安装](install-with-agent.md)这份说明交给它：它先把 Mika 装到手机上；你也要电脑访问的话，它会按你选的入口接着配好。

## 电脑任务台（`mika ui`）

也可以通过可选的[飞书连接器](feishu.md)扫码创建或关联机器人，在飞书私聊中派任务和接收结果；电脑仍需保持在线。

不想敲命令时，连好手机后运行 `mika ui`，电脑浏览器会打开一个任务台：派任务、看步骤进度、回答追问、追加要求、取消任务，其他入口派的近期任务也会列出来。页面在后台时默认暂停读取，切回来再更新；需要接管的步骤要在手机上处理。界面按浏览器语言显示简体中文或英文。

左侧把最近 50 个远程任务按对话归组。中央按轮次显示要求和答复。一轮结束后，在底部继续输入会沿用同一对话。点某一轮的「查看过程」，手机状态和本页观察到的进展会在这一轮的答复上方展开。点「收起过程」即可合上。底部输入框保留当前草稿。需要另起一段时，点「新对话」。

在手机「设置 → 连接电脑 → 高级设置」打开「允许电脑查看历史记录」后，左侧还会列出手机保存的对话，包括直接在手机上发起的对话。用「加载更多对话」和「加载更早的轮次」继续翻阅。手机发起的任务可在这里查看，在手机上继续或处理追问。此开关默认关闭，授权范围包含所有对话、运行记录和已录制的 Trace 正文，USB 与私有网络连接共用。

展开某一轮的「查看过程」，可读手机保存的运行事件及详细 Trace。Trace 按步骤列出模型请求、工具调用、耗时、输入与缓存用量以及首处变化的块；点「查看请求与回复」按页读取已脱敏正文。录制中的内容随当前页面更新，切换轮次保留输入草稿。详细录制需要事先在调试版或性能测试版的开发者选项里开启。未录制、记录被清理或只录到一部分时，页面会说明当前可用情况。

想在别的窗口工作时收到提醒，点左下角的手机连接状态，开启「电脑提醒」，并在浏览器中允许通知。任务台只在发现需要回答、需要手机接管、完成或失败时提醒。点击通知会回到对应对话的那一轮。首次开启时已显示的任务状态和普通步骤更新都保持安静。

默认关闭提醒。开启后，同一浏览器里只需留一个任务台标签页，切到后台也能收到通知，开多个标签页也只提醒一次。电脑系统需要允许浏览器显示通知。电脑休眠、浏览器挂起页面或手机断线时，要等恢复连接后才能读到最新状态。关闭所有任务台标签页或退出浏览器后，提醒会暂停，重新打开时不会补发关闭期间的通知。

支持任务恢复的手机会记住每次提交的编号。如果断线时没有收到回执，重新连接后任务台会按编号核对近期任务。原任务没出现在近期列表时，可以点「查找原任务」。找不到时可点「用同一编号重试」。刷新同一标签页后仍可核对，任务台会保留待核对的原始要求，直到找回、重试成功或手动放弃核对。

- 多台 ADB 设备时，在页面里选一台，或启动时用 `mika ui --device SERIAL` 指定；Wi-Fi / 私有 VPN 连接沿用 `--url` 和 `--token-file`。
- 只装了 Skill 时用 `python3 <技能目录>/mika/scripts/mika_cli.py ui`（Windows 用 `py -3`）。
- 浏览器没自动打开时加 `--no-open`，把终端打出的链接复制到本机浏览器。
- 任务台只监听本机 `127.0.0.1` 的随机端口，每次启动生成新的链接；链接里的密钥就是使用权，不要发给别人。终端按 Ctrl+C 关掉任务台，已经交给手机的任务照常运行。

## 导出运行记录

任务卡住、结果不对，或要交给电脑上的另一个工具排障时，用同一套连接把手机上这一轮的脱敏记录拉下来。它和手机里「查看过程」是同一份事件，再过一遍脱敏；默认不带截图文件。

```bash
mika task export TASK_OR_RUN_ID --json
```

返回的 JSON 里 `exportFormat` 为 1，并写明 `task_id`、`conversation_id`、run_id（和 `task status` 里的 `conversation` 是同一个对话编号）。`partial` 为 true 表示这一轮还在进行，内容是到目前为止的事件。编号不存在时命令会失败并给出明确错误。只要事件、一行一个：`mika task export ID --events`。

任务台里的「查看过程」仍是本页观察到的进度，不是这份完整事件流。在任务台上下载同一份 JSON、附带 OTLP Trace 或截图，留作后续。

### Disclaimer, data and privacy

# Disclaimer, data and privacy

[简体中文](disclaimer.md) | English

## Beta notes

- This is an early public beta. Features and UI are still changing quickly, and upgrades may include breaking changes.
- So far it has mainly been tested on one Android 14 phone. Other Android versions and other phones may hit problems we have not seen yet; [reports are welcome](../.github/CONTRIBUTING.md#reporting-issues).
- Mika operates third-party apps and websites on your behalf. Please read the disclaimer below first.

## Disclaimer

- Operating third-party apps and websites through automation may violate their terms of service and carries a risk of restricted features or account bans. Use your own judgment, at your own risk.
- You are responsible for actions you approve (and for actions Mika takes on your behalf in Autonomous mode). For anything important, use Ask mode and check the results (see [Ask and Autonomous](modes.en.md)).
- This is beta software, provided "as is", without warranty of any kind (see [LICENSE](../LICENSE)).

## Data and privacy

- **There is no Mika server.** What you say, screen contents and screenshots go only to the model provider you configure.
- API keys, memories and your user profile are encrypted with the Android Keystore and stored on the phone. Conversations, run records and token usage stay on the device.
- Update checks only contact GitHub.
- The built-in browser visits only the sites you send it to; the sandbox is online by default, and you can turn it off in Settings.

## License and third-party components

Mika is released under the [Apache License 2.0](../LICENSE); see [NOTICE](../NOTICE) for the copyright notice.

Third-party components keep their own licenses; see [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../licenses/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md). In particular, the APK contains standalone executables `libproot.so` and `libproot_loader.so` built from PRoot (GPL-2.0-or-later, statically linked with talloc, LGPL-3.0-or-later); Mika only runs them as child processes. Source locations and checksums are in [`tools/sandbox/sources.lock`](../tools/sandbox/sources.lock), patches are in `tools/sandbox/patches/`, and they can be rebuilt with `tools/sandbox/build-native.sh`. The sandbox runtime (a minimal Alpine Linux 3.22 root filesystem and packages) ships with the APK, and the matching source packages are attached to each release; see [`tools/sandbox/README.md`](../tools/sandbox/README.md) for how.

## 数据与隐私
